title: Feedback verification receipts
boundary: Human attestations only. The server checks recorded references, not whether a test ran or the defect was fixed. No agent, command, task status change or release is triggered.
requirements: Select a failed check on the feedback’s full source commit and a later passed check with exactly the same recorded command. The fix delivery must use that source commit as its base, with the same task, repository and workspace.
readError: Verification references are unavailable or access changed. Refresh and check task access.
limited: Only the latest 50 deliveries and 20 historical attestations are shown.
previewError: The selected evidence is unavailable or does not meet the fixed-reference requirements. Check the coding delivery receipts and preview again.
awaiting: Not yet confirmed. Commands and log locations are intentionally omitted; inspect the original coding receipts before attesting.
confirm_reproduction: I inspected the original receipt and confirm this failed check reproduced this feedback.
confirm_fix: I inspected the proposed fix and original receipt and confirm this later check verifies the feedback regression.
confirm_environment: I checked that the environments are comparable. Matching command digests alone do not prove this; the server has not verified the environments.
saveError: Confirmation was not acknowledged. Inspect history, retry the same request, or cancel and preview fresh references.
historical: This immutable receipt covers only the references shown. It is not current success, release approval, or an independently verified test result.
